dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: A concise view of the Safir catalogue and the content that needs your attention.

cards.description: Manage every card available in Safir, including classification, translations, stats, and artwork.
cards.emptyDescription: Create your first Safir card to get started.
cards.createDescription: Add content, translations, classification, and artwork.
cards.editDescription: Update card data without changing its technical identifiers.
cards.paginationNote: Search currently filters the loaded catalogue server-side by name, number, and slug. Cursor-based Firestore pagination can be added when the catalogue outgrows this first back-office dataset.
cards.loadErrorDescription: Check the Firebase connection and try again.

import.title: Import cards
import.description: Choose the target season, review the file, then import valid cards into the catalogue.
import.destinationDescription: Every card in the file will be assigned to the same season.
import.fallbackRarityHelp: Optional — only used when rarity_slug is empty.
import.fileDescription: The file is checked in the browser before anything is written to Firestore.
import.fileHint: JSON array · 5 MB maximum · 400 cards maximum
import.previewTitle: {count, plural, one {# card detected} other {# cards detected}}
import.missingRarityWarning: {count, plural, one {# card without a rarity will be skipped. Choose a fallback rarity to include it.} other {# cards without a rarity will be skipped. Choose a fallback rarity to include them.}}
import.issuesDescription: These cards were neither changed nor created.
import.issuesLimited: The report shows the first {count} issues.
import.duplicateNote: A card with the same number in this season will be skipped. Existing data is never overwritten.
import.mappingDescription: rarity_slug, type_slugs and faction_slug are matched to existing references. Commanders are detected through is_commander; other cards are imported as combatants.
import.imageNote: Images keep their HTTPS image_url and can later be replaced from the card page.
import.seasonRequired: Select the season for the cards being imported.
import.fileRequired: Choose a JSON file to import.
import.fileTooLarge: The JSON file exceeds the 5 MB limit.
import.arrayRequired: The JSON root must be an array of cards.
import.emptyFile: The JSON array contains no cards.
import.tooManyRows: An import is limited to {count} cards.
import.invalidJson: The file does not contain valid JSON.
import.seasonMissing: The selected season no longer exists.
import.fallbackRarityMissing: The selected fallback rarity no longer exists.
import.issueDuplicateNumber: Number {number} already exists in this season or appears more than once in the file.
import.issueMissingRarity: No rarity_slug and no fallback rarity.
import.nothingImported: No valid card could be imported.
import.success: {imported, plural, one {# card imported} other {# cards imported}} · {skipped, plural, =0 {no skipped rows} one {# skipped row} other {# skipped rows}}.
import.sessionExpired: Your administrator session has expired. Sign in again before restarting the import.
import.serviceError: The import could not be completed. No card from this batch was written.

seasons.description: Organize the Codex timeline and select the single season featured on the public home page.
seasons.emptyDescription: Create the first season before adding sets and cards.
seasons.createDescription: Add a localized season and configure its public visibility.
seasons.editDescription: Changes are validated server-side before Firestore is updated.

sets.description: Group cards into releases that belong to a specific season.
sets.emptyDescription: Create a set within one of your existing seasons.
sets.createDescription: Attach this release to one season and localize its public identity.
sets.editDescription: The season relationship is enforced again during every server mutation.

rarities.description: Manage rarities, their colors, icons, and display order.
rarities.emptyDescription: Create the rarities used to classify cards.
rarities.createDescription: Define a localized rarity with a clear color and catalogue order.
rarities.editDescription: Preview visual changes before saving them to the catalogue.

types.description: Maintain the multi-select taxonomy used to classify cards.
types.emptyDescription: Create the gameplay types available in card classification.
types.createDescription: Add a reusable card classification with localized labels.
types.editDescription: Update this type across every card that references it.

factions.title: Factions
factions.description: Manage the factions used by deck compatibility rules.
factions.emptyDescription: Create factions before assigning them to cards.
factions.createDescription: Add a stable, localized identity reusable by cards.
factions.editDescription: Cards retain its stable identifier when it changes.

glossary.description: Manage rules terms, stable keys, and localized definitions.
glossary.emptyDescription: Add the first rules term and its translations.
glossary.createDescription: Add a stable technical key, a slug, and localized definitions.
glossary.editDescription: The technical key stays stable while labels and definitions are localized.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Customize your admin workspace and find Safirdex's essential access points.

appearance.title: Appearance and language
appearance.description: Adapt the administration interface to the way you work.

website.title: View the public website
website.description: Leave the administration area and immediately review what visitors can see.

account.title: Account and security
account.description: Manage your password and the access linked to your administrator account.

configuration.title: Active configuration
configuration.description: The main services used by this installation.

system.title: System
system.description: Manage Safirdex's global availability and operational application features.

maintenance.title: Maintenance mode
maintenance.description: Temporarily suspend public access during an update or intervention. Administrators retain access.

toggle.label: Enable maintenance mode
toggle.description: When enabled, Safirdex becomes unavailable to regular users. Administrators and sign-in remain available.

content.title: Maintenance message
content.description: Customize the content shown to visitors in each language.

estimate.title: Estimated return
estimate.description: Add an optional date and display an informative countdown.
estimate.label: Date and time
estimate.help: Maintenance mode will not be disabled automatically when the countdown reaches zero.

feedback.error: The configuration could not be saved.

summary.activeDescription: The public application is blocked. You can continue working from the administration area.
summary.readyDescription: Visitors are currently using Safirdex normally.
summary.adminAccess: Custom Claims protect the administrator bypass.
summary.cache: The status is cached and invalidated after every change.

confirmation.title: Enable maintenance mode?
confirmation.description: Users will be unable to access Safirdex until it is disabled. Your administrator access will remain available.

dialogs.deleteDescription: This action cannot be undone. Associated assets may also be removed from storage.

forms.name: Name
forms.label: Label
forms.generalSetDescription: A set always belongs to exactly one season.
forms.generalSeasonDescription: Season order, public URL, and release status.
forms.translationDescription: Names and descriptions use the central locale registry.
forms.activeHelp: This season is available in the public Codex.
forms.featuredHelp: Featuring this season automatically clears the previous one.
forms.seasonArtworkHelp: Optional cover artwork used on featured season surfaces.
forms.stableKeyDescription: The stable key is what card descriptions reference.
forms.keyWarning: Changing a key that is already in use can break existing card references.
forms.tooltipPreviewHelp: Hover or focus the term to inspect its definition.
forms.definitionPreview: Add a definition to preview the tooltip.
forms.visualGeneralDescription: Configure how this content is identified and ordered.
forms.colorHelp: Use a hexadecimal color such as #8B5CF6.
forms.iconLimits: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, or SVG · up to 15 MB
forms.mainArtworkHelp: The original image is never cropped in Admin.
forms.dropArtwork: Drop artwork here or choose a file
forms.artworkLimits: JPG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF · up to 15 MB
forms.setReset: The previous set was cleared because it belongs to another season.
forms.classificationDescription: Rarity and one or more gameplay types.
forms.statsDescription: Each gameplay statistic must be an integer from 0 to 10.
forms.commanderHelp: This card can be used as a Commander.
forms.promoHelp: This card belongs to a promotional release.
forms.featuredCardHelp: Highlight this card on curated surfaces.
forms.cardTranslationsDescription: Choose a primary language; incomplete languages are clearly marked and can be completed later.
forms.cardDescriptionPlaceholder: Describe the card. Insert glossary terms with [[key]].
forms.alternativeArtworksHelp: Each artwork has an independent stable ID and explicit display order.
forms.systemInformationHelp: Read-only identifiers useful for support and debugging.
forms.visualPreviewDescription: A quick approximation of the public badge.

feedback.service: The catalogue service could not complete this operation. Please try again.
feedback.factionInUse: This faction is still used by at least one card.

feedback.patchNoteUnpublished: News article moved back to drafts.
